# Document service architecture

This example service is a teaching model, not a source-verified map of this repository.
Follow the same Client, Document API, and Document Store from the overview to the details.
The request latency is $T = T_{api} + T_{store}$.

$$
T_{store} = T_{queue} + T_{write}
$$

The client sends a complete document, not a patch.

```typescript
const request = { title: "System guide", blocks: [] };
await client.replaceDocument(request);
```

slides.title: System overview
slides.mermaid:
flowchart LR

  subgraph Backend["Example backend"]

slides.explanationMarkdown:
This deck explains how a document reaches persistent storage.
The Client submits a document to the Document API, and the Document Store owns persistence inside the example backend.
This overview establishes the request path but omits validation and storage internals.
The next slide expands the Document API before following its request into the Document Store.

slides.title: Document API detail
slides.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Client["Client"] --> Api["Document API — 文件 API"]
  subgraph ApiDetail["Document API internals"]
    Api --> Validator["Request Validator — check the complete document before any storage operation"]
    Validator --> Handler["Request Handler"]
  end
  Handler --> Store["Document Store — 工作區文件儲存與版本資料"]
slides.explanationMarkdown:
The Document API from the overview now expands into a Request Validator and a Request Handler.
This slide explains the example's assumption that validation runs before persistence.
The Request Handler passes the validated request to the Document Store, which remains one node here and becomes the focus of the next slide.
The long validator label and the Chinese API and storage labels are rendering fixtures.

slides.title: Document Store detail
slides.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Api["Document API — 文件 API"] --> Store["Document Store — 工作區文件儲存與版本資料"]
  subgraph StorageDetail["Document Store internals"]
    Store --> Queue["Write Queue"]
    Queue --> Revision["Revision Check"]
    Revision --> Temp["Temporary JSON File"]
    Temp --> Commit["Atomic Rename"]
    Commit --> Files["Document Files"]
  end
